column2:
Analyze my content vs. my competitors' content. Here's what I need:
My website/blog: [your URL or describe your existing content]
Competitor 1: [URL]
Competitor 2: [URL]
My target keywords/topics: [list the topics you want to rank for or be known for]
Identify: (1) Topics my competitors cover that I don't (content gaps), (2) Topics I cover that they don't (my advantages), (3) Topics no one covers well that I could own, (4) Content formats they use that I'm missing (video, podcasts, tools, templates, etc.), (5) Their top-performing content (by estimated traffic/engagement) and what I can learn from it, (6) A prioritized list of 10 content pieces I should create next, ranked by impact potential. For each recommendation, include the target keyword and a suggested angle that differentiates my take.
